content:
maya: Heads-up — NorthRipples usage down ~64% over the last 14 days. Primary champion (Lina) left last week, procurement reached out asking about a competitor POC. Renewal in 5 months, we should triage now.

alejandro: On it. Quick summary from my call: Lina's backup (Trevor) is steering procurement. They're evaluating VeridianAI next week. No formal POC doc yet, but they asked for an integration checklist + a short exec ROI slide.

jess: They still have 3 outstanding onboarding tasks in our queue: SSO, webhook mapping for customer events, and the demo templates. I haven't been looped into the procurement timeline.

samir: From product side the webhook mapping is trivial to expedite. SSO requires a staging slot from infra but is doable within a day once granted.

maya: Proposed playbook:
1) AE intro to new PO + procurement steering call (Alejandro)
2) Offer 2-week cost-free dedicated trial (to mirror competitor POC) + sample traffic reproducible test
3) Fast-track SSO + webhook this week
4) Ship a 1-page ROI showing cost/latency/UX wins + 3 tailored demo scripts
Are we aligned?

alejandro: Agree. I'll intro Trevor + procurement lead right now. Can we get an ROI one-pager by EOD? I have a base deck but need up-to-date usage numbers.

jess: I can finish the webhook mapping tomorrow if we get API keys and an admin session. SSO needs ops approval — @opsbot can you allocate a staging SSO slot to northripples-staging?

opsbot: opsbot: Access request received for "northripples-staging". Estimated provisioning ETA ~6 hours. Please confirm approver: alejandro.

samir: I'll prepare a condensed ROI snippet showing token savings from prefix caching + latency improvements for the demo flows. Send me the last 90-day token counts (CSV) and sample transcripts.

maya: Quick token snapshot from logs (placeholder):
| day  | tokens | active_users |
| ---- | ------ | ------------- |
| -14  | 120000 | 42 |
| -7   | 48000  | 19 |
| -1   | 36000  | 12 |
Will attach proper CSV to this thread.

alejandro: Intro email sent to Trevor + procurement lead (cc'ed). Trevor replied: POC timeline starts Monday; internal demo Friday. He asked for an "integration checklist" and an exec ROI to share with the VP of Ops.

jess: I'll draft the integration checklist and a one-page runbook for the demo (SSO steps, webhook test, sample prompts). Uploading to #shared-cs-resources when done.

maya: Meeting: 30m sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to align deliverables and confirm who presents demo. Action items recap:
- Alejandro: AE intro + confirm procurement timeline (done)
- Jess: SSO & webhook prioritization, checklist/runbook
- Samir: ROI snippet with token numbers
- Maya: Account play + sample demo scripts; prepare provisional credit offer (12k tokens)
AEs: can you confirm approval for the provisional credit so I can include in outreach?

alejandro: Provisional approval for up to 12k free tokens. I'll confirm with sales-ops for formal sign-off.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks. If they commit to POC, mark SFDC as "competitive-poc" and tag renewals. I'll update exec sponsor with the play and schedule the demo invite once Jess uploads the checklist.
